tools.name: scm.repos.list
tools.description: List repositories the authenticated user can access on the given platform. Omit `platform` to use [scm.default].

account.description: Which configured account to fan out over, when more than one is configured for this platform (e.g. two GitHub accounts). Omit to list every configured account of `platform` at once — each repo in the response is tagged with the `account` that returned it.

platform.description: Platform to query (`github` | `gitlab`). Omit to use [scm.default].

tools.name: scm.branches.create
tools.description: Create a new branch from a given SHA. Returns the new branch.

account.description: Which configured account to use, when more than one is configured for this platform (e.g. two GitHub accounts). Only needed when `[[scm.rules]]` don't disambiguate.
